_doc: guitar_anchors: strap buttons in the guitar root frame (x across strings, y nut(+)->body(-), z out of the fretboard).
end_pin = bottom face of G:body (y=-0.4-0.17); heel = top edge of G:body, just behind the back face.
route: initial guide points only (end_pin -> right waist -> back -> over left shoulder -> left chest -> heel),
body-local, SMPL frame: +x left, -y forward, +z up. Chosen ~5-7 cm outside the capsules in the seated pose;
the strap drapes onto the body during settle_steps, so they need not be exact.
colliders: body name -> its fromto capsule in smpl_mpl_hands_body.xml; or an explicit body-local capsule
(Pelvis is a box in the MJCF, so it is approximated by a hip-wide capsule).
The R_Thorax capsule closes the back of the right armpit (scapula / posterior axillary fold). SMPL capsules
leave that region open because the right arm reaches forward, and the strap would otherwise ride up the
back, over the right shoulder, and hang around the neck like a necklace.
